repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: M3 受體拮抗 → 腸道平滑肌痙攣抑制 → 可能緩解 IBS 腹痛/腸痙攣；同類藥物（hyoscine、dicyclomine）已有 IBS 適應症，glycopyrronium 具相同作用機轉，但尚無直接臨床資料
馬尾神經壓迫造成膀胱/直腸功能障礙屬結構性損傷；抗膽鹼劑或能緩解繼發性逼尿肌過動症狀，但無法改善神經壓迫根本病因，機轉連結極弱，無任何臨床資料
M2/M3 受體拮抗 → 抑制逼尿肌不自主收縮 → 改善神經因性膀胱過動症狀；同類藥物（oxybutynin、tolterodine、solifenacin）為神經因性膀胱一線治療，glycopyrronium 具完全相同的作用機轉，但本資料集中無直接臨床試驗或文獻支持
Da Costa 症候群具自律神經失調特徵（心悸、出汗、功能性心血管症狀）；glycopyrronium 周邊抗膽鹼效應理論上可調節部分症狀，但機轉連結不明確，無任何臨床資料，不構成研究優先議題

literature.title: Botulinum Treatment Induced Dropped Head Syndrome in a Patient With Chronic Migraines and Multiple Sclerosis.
literature.abstract: Chronic migraine treatment typically is treated medically by use of medications, such as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and triptans; however, for a subset of patients, botulinum toxin (or Botox) has effectively been shown to be an alternative medication.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 偏頭痛涉及三叉血管神經路徑與 CGRP/5-HT 系統；抗毒蕈鹼機轉與主流治療靶點無直接連結；唯一文獻為肉毒桿菌素引起垂頭症候群的案例報告，與 glycopyrronium 完全無關
腦幹先兆偏頭痛涉及後循環及腦幹功能異常；glycopyrronium 幾乎不穿越血腦屏障，無法作用於中樞腦幹路徑，機轉連結缺失，無任何臨床資料
⚠️ 安全疑慮旗標：抗毒蕈鹼藥物可能引起瞳孔散大（虹膜括約肌鬆弛），在窄角型青光眼列為禁忌症；開角型青光眼雖風險相對較低，但 glycopyrronium 無降低眼內壓的藥理機轉，不具治療根據

clinical_trials.title: Effects of Long Acting Bronchodilators on CARDiac Autonomic Nervous System Control in Patients With COPD
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The aim of this interventional, randomized, double-blind, monocentric, cross-over study is to quantify the possible deleterious effect on the cardiac autonomic nervous system control of two long-acting anticholinergic bronchodilatators (tiotropium and glycopyrronium) and one beta-2 agonist long-acting bronchodilatator (indacaterol ) in patients with mild COPD.

relevance.reasoning: Phase 4 完成試驗（42 名 COPD 患者），直接研究長效支氣管擴張劑（含 glycopyrronium）對心臟自律神經系統控制的效應；雖主要族群為 COPD 而非原發性自律神經疾病，但提供 glycopyrronium 影響自律神經功能的直接臨床量測資料

literature.title: The Movement Disorder Society Evidence-Based Medicine Review Update: Treatments for the non-motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease.
literature.journal: Movement disorders : official journal of the Movement Disorder Society
literature.abstract: The Movement Disorder Society (MDS) Task Force on Evidence-Based Medicine (EBM) Review of Treatments for Parkinson's Disease (PD) was first published in 2002 and was updated in 2005 to cover clinical trial data up to January 2004 with the focus on motor symptoms of PD. In this revised version the MDS task force decided it was necessary to extend the review to non-motor symptoms. The objective of this work was to update previous EBM reviews on treatments for PD with a focus on non-motor symptoms.

literature.title: State-of-the-art pharmacotherapy for autonomic dysfunction in Parkinson's disease.
literature.abstract: Introduction: Autonomic dysfunction is one of the most frequent and disabling non-motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease (PD). It includes, among others, orthostatic hypotension (OH), sialorrhea, constipation, erectile dysfunction (ED), urinary dysfunction, and diaphoresis. We undertook morphological and functional studies to assess large myelinated and small unmyelinated axons in the db/db type II diabetes mouse model. literature.title: Emerging drugs for autonomic dysfunction in Parkinson's disease.
literature.abstract: Autonomic dysfunction, including orthostatic hypotension (OH), sialorrhea, sexual dysfunction, urinary dysfunction and constipation is a common feature of Parkinson's disease (PD). Even though its treatment has been recognized as a major unmet need in PD, there is a paucity of clinical trials to assess their treatment.

literature.abstract: Hyperhidrosis, or excessive sweating, is characterized by overactivity of the eccrine sweat glands, usually associated with dysfunction of the autonomic nervous system. literature.title: Parasympathetic neural activity accounts for the lowering of exercise heart rate at high altitude.
literature.abstract: In chronic hypoxia, both heart rate (HR) and cardiac output (Q) are reduced during exercise. The role of parasympathetic neural activity in lowering HR is unresolved, and its influence on Q and oxygen transport at high altitude has never been studied.

literature.title: Cardiovascular autonomic function in patients with hemodynamic instability at induction of capnoperitoneum: a case-control study.
literature.abstract: This study hypothesized that patients in whom bradycardia and hypotension develop with induction of positive-pressure capnoperitoneum have an underlying autonomic cardiovascular dysfunction.

literature.title: Mechanism of hypotensive transients associated with abrupt bradycardias in conscious rabbits.
literature.abstract: Transient bradycardic hypotensive events occur in resting rabbits. If the hypotension is due to vasodepression, these events may be a model for vasovagal syncope.

literature.title: Effect of central cholinergic stimulation on regional cerebral blood flow in Alzheimer disease.
literature.abstract: Patients with Alzheimer disease (AD) had reduced regional cerebral blood flow (rCBF) in the posterior parietotemporal region compared with controls, as determined with technetium-99m hexamethyl propyleneamine oxime and single photon emission tomography. Central cholinergic stimulation with physostigmine produced a focal increase in rCBF in the posterior parietotemporal region in the patients with AD but not in controls.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 周邊 M 型受體拮抗 → 調節膽鹼能支配的自律神經效應器（唾液腺、汗腺、心臟竇房結、膀胱逼尿肌、腸道平滑肌）；已核准/使用中的自律神經失調適應症包含：帕金森病流涎（PD 自律神經症狀）、原發性多汗症（交感膽鹼能支配）；COPD 臨床試驗顯示對心臟自律神經功能有可量測效應
⚠️ 安全疑慮旗標：遺傳性青光眼患者眼壓管理更為困難；抗毒蕈鹼藥物可能加劇眼壓升高風險（瞳孔擴大影響房水流出），無降眼壓藥理機轉，禁忌傾向明確
持續性憂鬱症與單胺系統（5-HT、NE、DA）失調相關；抗毒蕈鹼機轉與憂鬱症標準治療靶點不符；部分研究顯示抗膽鹼藥物可能因認知副作用加重情緒症狀，不構成治療根據
